meta.claritySummary:
The attempt reads as a coherent work session. Stages follow the order they were given, the notes and tool marks are usable, and idle on the coding recording is named as idle rather than work. Clarity here is how the session ran from Conversation, Assist, editor history, and task marks - not how they speak, and not a diagnosis.

A reviewer can move through Overview without reconstructing a broken session. Follow-through held on the stages they opened. Assist asks stayed pointed at the brief.

clarityChecks.note: They finished the stages in the order they were given.
The notes and tool marks are usable as evidence, not a dump of how they speak.
The record is readable as a coherent work session. Idle clocks stay idle.
This reading combines focus, pace, follow-through, assist judgment, artifact usability, and continuity.
On-stage time concentrated on Coding. Opening and Writing were thinner. Read the notes on the thinner stages before calling it neglect. This clock does not change the overall score.
Keystroke gaps stretched on Coding. A long pause next to a short typical gap is stop-start typing: searching, correcting, or thinking, not a typing-speed score.
Five files were touched on Coding. Hopping can be exploring or searching. Read what shipped in the last snapshots, not the hop count as scatter.

clarityPoints: Stages follow each other in the order they were given.
Nothing in the record looks scrambled or worth an anomaly look.
